name: Deputy Rainer
summary: At Westbrook Garrison, Deputy Rainer holds Elwynn's western border against threats from Westfall. The Stormwind Army officer coordinates the local defense, though reinforcements have not arrived.

sections.title: Holding the Western Border
sections.body:
Westbrook Garrison guards Elwynn Forest's western edge, where the road crosses into Westfall. Political paralysis in Stormwind City leaves much of the army abroad or caught in bureaucracy, and border posts like this one lack troops. Deputy Rainer organizes the defense outside the tower with the few forces at hand.

Riverpaw gnolls and wandering thieves threaten the local roads. Rainer depends on passing travelers and mercenary adventurers to keep the forest trails secure.

sections.title: The Road to Westfall
sections.body: Deputy Rainer watches for the Riverpaw pack and warns travelers about Hogger, the infamous gnoll chieftain. He also carries word of the troubled lands beyond the river. The chaos at Elwynn's border begins in Westfall's lawless farmlands, so he sends capable volunteers across the border to Gryan Stoutmantle and the struggling People's Militia.

faq.answer: Deputy Rainer is a Stormwind Army officer stationed at Westbrook Garrison on Elwynn Forest's western edge. He oversees road security and hires adventurers to fight nearby threats.

Most of the Stormwind Army is deployed elsewhere, and political disorder in the capital keeps regular reinforcements from reaching outlying regions. Marshal Dughan in Goldshire must rely on independent adventurers to help Rainer.

faq.q: What threats is Rainer trying to counter?
faq.answer: Rainer works to contain the Riverpaw gnolls in the woods south of the garrison, roving thieves, and Hogger, the notorious gnoll chieftain who preys on travelers along the border.

faq.q: Where does Rainer send adventurers after clearing the gnolls?
faq.answer: After the gnolls near the garrison are driven back, Rainer sends seasoned adventurers across the western border into Westfall. There they help Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, you see how Stormwind's outlying garrisons adapt when regular royal support does not reach them.
